review_method: Main agent inspected rendered 90-dpi pages and a full-resolution actual prediction example

page_content.1: Title, abstract, introduction and related work legible
page_content.2: Pipeline, method and equation contained in page bounds
page_content.3: Fairness table, data and metric protocol legible
page_content.4: Results, reference sensitivity and limitations; no missing macros
page_content.5: Verified-quality table, actual pseudo examples and main2D table
page_content.6: Main6D and severity tables, measured severity graph
page_content.7: Student improvement and deterioration examples, all-control/recording/visible66 tables
page_content.8: Detection-penalty tie example and final reference; lower whitespace retained

limitations: IEEE float placement leaves whitespace on final page and some small supplementary table text; suitable author-review draft, not final journal typesetting approval.
